improvements.reason: After an uncertain commit, the source clears pending confirmation. The .NET workflow retains a recovery-only checkpoint and its original idempotency identity: unrelated reads can proceed, but confirmation and another prepare cannot accidentally repeat an unverified mutation. No calculated figure or recorded successful response changes.

This hosted runtime deliberately requires AI_INJECTION_GUARD and AI_OUTPUT_POLICY to remain on, and AI_GATEWAY_TLS_VERIFY to remain true. Unsupported disabling settings fail startup explicitly rather than silently pretending to honor them. The source permits some diagnostic control overrides; enabling those overrides in .NET requires a separate owner decision.

Malformed boolean configuration is rejected with a value-free startup error instead of being silently interpreted as false. This prevents a spelling mistake from quietly disabling an intended control; supported boolean settings and all 39 deterministic records retain their behavior.
